messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert SVC-CACHE-READ-ERR rate spike -> error budget consuming, 90th latency > 1.2s for prefix lookups. Paging emma-oncall.

emma-oncall: acknowledged. Investigating. tagging @sanjay-platform and @devin-runtime.

sanjay-platform: I can join in 1-2m. any obvious deployment or rollout?

emma-oncall: no deploys in the last hour. metric highlights: prefix-read QPS jumped x3 from baseline, KV miss-rate up ~18% and we see a lot of consistency fallback reads (origin hits).

devin-runtime: logs show increased timeouts to our redis-like prefix store, and a few 5xx traces from the caching layer. sample trace: ```
ERR prefix read timeout id=0x8f3c path=/kv/prefix/abcd duration=1200ms
stack: cache.lookup -> cache.fetchRemote -> tcpTimeout
```

lina-support: any customer-facing errors? Support queue seeing a handful of slow-generating responses flagged by customers (customer-facing latency, not 5xx). I have heartbeat checks open.

emma-oncall: assessment: correctness not currently degraded but risk is rising — a handful of requests hit origin fallback which is heavier. Need to reduce load to cache to protect integrity and avoid tail latency for other tenants.

devin-runtime: propose immediate mitigations: 1) apply conservative rate limiting at edge for non-SLA tenants (burst 200 -> 50) 2) enable KV read-safe-mode: bypass prefix cache for any keys with recent error spikes (selective bypass) 3) increase cache RPC timeout to avoid cascading retries.

sanjay-platform: prefer 1+2 now. 3 might hide root cause. Also suggest temporary small quota trims for noisy tenants (per-tenant throttle).

emma-oncall: action plan and owner: 
- emma-oncall: coordinate customer comms and monitoring
- devin-runtime: run selective bypass patch and adjust edge limiter
- sanjay-platform: roll per-tenant quota changes via runtime-config
- ops-bot: annotate incident channel and set status page stub if customer impact surfaces

ops-bot: Command accepted: initiating edge-rate-adjust for non-sla group -> new limit 50rps.

devin-runtime: applying selective KV bypass rule: keys with >5 timeout errors in last 5m will go origin-first. patch applied to runtime routing. rolling 20% canary -> 100% in 90s.

emma-oncall: canary looks ok so far, tail latency for cached reads down ~30% for healthy keys. But origin QPS increased 25% — monitor origin error rate.

sanjay-platform: applying tenant quota trims: tenants t-14 and t-21 get 30% quota reduction for 15m. Will observe throttling and customer impact.

lina-support: contacting top impacted customers with FYI: we may throttle some heavy requests to preserve overall service. drafting message: "We've applied temporary rate controls to reduce latency; you'll see reduced throughput for burst traffic. We're monitoring and will update."

emma-oncall: monitoring dashboards: origin error rate ticked up but still within acceptable. cache client retries reduced after timeout tweak. Current SLO risk lowered.

devin-runtime: noticed an edge case: bypassing prefix cache for some keys exposes a correctness safeguard we wanted — good. But we should avoid bypassing for keys with strong hot-join semantics; added exclusion rule for hot-hot keys with >10k QPS.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: 2419008000 mitigation milestone: edge rate limit applied, selective KV bypass at 100%, tenant quota trim active.

emma-oncall: quick customer impact summary for status page: "Intermittent higher latency observed for some customers; temporary rate controls and selective cache bypasses applied to protect service integrity. No data corruption observed. Teams are monitoring."

lina-support: sent messages to the 3 affected customers, all acked but asked for ETA. Sharing one reply: "Thanks — we'd prefer a heads-up when this clears."

devin-runtime: next steps: revert bypass once origin stabilization confirmed, and run focused cache health checks: prefix consistency scan, RPC latency histogram, and a small traffic-replay against a staging cluster to reproduce.
sanjay-platform: ETA for traffic-normalization target: 30-45m. I'll prepare rollback knobs: revert tenant trims, remove edge limit, and re-enable normal prefix routing.

emma-oncall: setting reminder for handoff in 45m. If anything regresses, escalate to SEV-2.

ops-bot: incident timeline marker: 
- 2419007777 paged on-call
- 2419007860 edge limit canary started
- 2419007920 selective bypass rolled to 100%
- 2419008000 tenant trims active

emma-oncall: post-incident notes to capture: why did prefix store latency spike? logs show a network blip between region A and cache-populator cluster; follow up with infra networking. Also consider adding adaptive backpressure in the client to stop retries when RPC latency climbs.

lina-support: customers want follow-up timeline. I'll coordinate a brief postmortem blurb after the handoff.

devin-runtime: also adding a small live experiment: a graduated cache-ttl override for problematic keys (shorten TTL to reduce stale amplification) — we'll test in staging first.

emma-oncall: wrapping up: mitigations held, SLO risk reduced. handoff to next oncall @sanjay-platform in 30m for monitoring and follow-ups.

sanjay-platform: taking over at 2419008400. noted.

incident-bot: :information_source: Incident state -> mitigated (monitoring). No customer-facing page update required beyond FYI messages sent.

emma-oncall: thanks team. will write a short timeline + RCA draft.

lina-support: adding a note to support tickets linking to mitigation summary.

devin-runtime: unassigning, will follow infra network thread.

ops-bot: closing active action list for this thread.
